target.title: fix(ui): chat workspace panel leaves an empty gap when collapsed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the session workspace panel in the Control UI chat view wasted horizontal space on both sides of its toggle:

- **Collapsed**, it still reserved a 52px empty rail on the right edge — a permanent dead gap with two orphaned icons floating in it. The panel looked half-closed instead of closed.
- **Expanded**, it floated inside the content gutter with a rounded corner and a ~20px strip of dead background between the panel and the window edge.

## Why This Change Was Made

The panel now behaves like the docked terminal at the bottom of the shell:

- **Collapsed**: the workbench grid drops the rail column entirely (`minmax(0, 1fr)` single column) and the expand toggle floats over the chat's top-right corner as a small glass button, matching the existing circular nav-toggle pattern. The decorative file icon in the collapsed strip was removed along with its now-dead CSS.
- **Expanded**: the chat content area drops its right gutter and squares the card's right corners (guarded to viewports >1120px, where the rail actually renders), so the panel closes flush against the window edge.

The toggle keeps its accessible name (`Expand session workspace`) and `aria-expanded` state.

## User Impact

Closing the workspace panel gives the full width back to the chat; opening it docks the panel flush to the window edge like the terminal drawer. The expand control stays visible and clickable in the top-right corner, so the panel remains one click away.

## Evidence

**Before** — collapsed panel still reserves an empty rail (note the gap on the right edge):

![before: collapsed rail reserves an empty 52px column](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/before-collapsed.png)

**After (collapsed)** — the rail takes no width; the expand toggle floats in the corner:

![after: collapsed rail takes no width, floating expand toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/after-collapsed.png)

**After (expanded)** — the open panel docks flush to the window edge (no gutter, square corners), like the bottom terminal:

![after: expanded workspace rail docked flush to the window edge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/after-expanded.png)

Validation (at the rebased head, post Control UI refactor #100024):

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts` — 92 passed, including the collapsed-rail test asserting the workbench drops the rail column and the floating toggle stays reachable.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts` — 19 passed (Playwright), covering collapse → expand → collapse round-trips, the new flush-edge assertion (`window.innerWidth - rail.getBoundingClientRect().right === 0` when expanded), and the ≤1120px viewport where the rail hides entirely.
- Screenshots captured with the repo's Playwright e2e harness (mock gateway, light theme, 1360×860@2x).
- `oxfmt --check` and `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` clean on touched files.
